slide_title: Extending the Range of Mendelian Genetics
original_text: Extending the Range of Mendelian Genetics
explanation: This slide continues the discussion on the extensions of Mendelian genetics, which address inheritance patterns that cannot be fully explained by simple dominant/recessive rules of single genes.

questions.q: Which of the following traits is typically explained by extending the range of Mendelian genetics rather than simple dominance?
questions.exp: Option B is correct because sickle cell anemia is mentioned on the previous slide as an example of pleiotropy, which is an extension of Mendelian inheritance.
